General.Privacy.Title: Privacy Policy for LAN-Party Mercurius Aalst and https://lan.mercurius-aalst.be
General.Privacy.IntroParagraph1: We value your privacy. This privacy policy explains which data we collect in the context of LAN-Party Mercurius Aalst, why we do so, and what your rights are.
General.Privacy.IntroParagraph2: This policy covers both the data you enter digitally (for competitions) and the data you provide physically or digitally when you arrive at the event. We comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Belgian law.
General.Privacy.ControllerIntro: The association responsible for processing your personal data is:
General.Privacy.DataCollectionHeading: Which data do we collect and when?
General.Privacy.PresenceIntro: When you arrive at the event in person, we ask you to register at the entrance. This is required to access the venue. We collect each of the following data points separately:
General.Privacy.ParticipationHeading: Participation data (through the Mercurius LAN platform)
General.Privacy.ParticipationIntro: If you want to participate in competitions or tournaments, you must register. This happens through the secure registration functionality of the Mercurius LAN platform. The following data is processed separately:
General.Privacy.PublicTournamentName: This name is used publicly in tournament brackets.
General.Privacy.InternalControl: For internal checks by the tournament administration.
General.Privacy.TournamentCommunication: For communication about the tournament. It is not made public.
General.Privacy.LinkedProfile: If provided, it is linked to your profile.
General.Privacy.NetworkIntro: If you connect to the available network during the event (wired or wireless), certain technical data is processed automatically.
General.Privacy.NetworkDataParagraph: This data is collected and stored temporarily during the event to make the connection possible. However, we as the organization (Mercurius Aalst) never take ownership of this data. Network management and data storage are fully the responsibility of the internet provider: Hogeschool Gent (HoGent). For more information, please consult HoGent's privacy policy:
General.Privacy.PurposesHeading: Why do we process this data?
General.Privacy.SecurityPurposeBody: To ensure the safety of everyone present and comply with the conditions of our insurance policy. In the event of an emergency (such as an evacuation) or an accident, we need an up-to-date list of everyone inside.
General.Privacy.StatisticsPurposeBody: To analyse how many unique visitors we had after the event. This data is anonymized for sponsor reporting (for example, "Total number of visitors").
General.Privacy.CompetitionPurposeBody: To seed tournaments using registration data from the Mercurius LAN platform, perform identity checks at prize ceremonies, and connect players with one another.
General.Privacy.PublicPurposeBody: To show brackets, leaderboards, and participant lists publicly on the website and screens during the event.
General.Privacy.NoticeBody: By registering for a competition (participation data), you agree that certain data will be made public.
General.Privacy.PubliclyVisibleBody: Your Full Name is linked to your Username. Your optional IDs (Steam, Discord, Riot) are also shown when provided.
General.Privacy.NotPublicBody: Your email address and the attendance-only list (visitors who are not playing) are never made public.
General.Privacy.LegitimateInterestBody: We have a legitimate interest in knowing who is in the building for safety, fire safety, and insurance reasons.
General.Privacy.ContractBody: To let you participate in the tournament, we need your player data through the platform's registration functionality.
General.Privacy.ConsentBody: For showing your specific game IDs.
General.Privacy.PlatformBody: Your participation data is processed within the services the platform offers for organizing tournaments.
General.Privacy.SponsorsBody: They receive only anonymized figures. They never see names or email addresses.
General.Privacy.InsurerBody: Your name and attendance data may be shared only in the event of a specific claim or accident.
General.Privacy.HoGentBody: It manages the technical network data (such as MAC addresses) directly. Mercurius Aalst has no access to this database.
General.Privacy.RetentionIntro: We distinguish between active contact details and historical data:
General.Privacy.PresenceRetentionBody: It is destroyed once the event has ended and the period for reporting accidents has passed (usually one month).
General.Privacy.ContactRetentionBody: They are kept for up to two years after the event so we can inform you about future editions if appropriate. They are then deleted.
General.Privacy.HistoricalRetentionBody: Data relevant to the history of the event (name, username, achieved results/ranking, and game IDs) is kept indefinitely. We do this based on our legitimate interest in maintaining a historical archive (Hall of Fame) of the event.
General.Privacy.RightsBody: You have the right to access, rectify, and delete your data. If you want historical data (such as your name in an old result) removed from our archive, please contact us at
General.Privacy.RightsResponse: We will respond to your request for access, rectification, or deletion within the legal period of one month after receiving it.
General.Privacy.ComplaintsBody: Complaints can be submitted to the Belgian Data Protection Authority
